sources.title: RAG Assistant - AI Chat with Multiple Models - Chrome Web Store
sources.snippet: Overview AI assistant for document analysis, web search, and productivity. Features voice transcription and customizable interactions. Transform your browsing experience with RAG Assistant, a comprehensive Chrome extension that brings intelligent AI assistance directly to your browser.

sources.title: GitHub - RF-D/ai-mem-rag-assistant
sources.snippet: AI Memory is an advanced conversational RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) assistant with persistent memory capabilities. The application leverages multiple large language models (LLMs) to provide accurate, contextually relevant responses by retrieving information from various sources.
